answer: Inside a storage of answers reused across many identities, the failure is quiet rather than loud. Here is where a gale actually earns its place — tie weight to recent graded output and halve it on idleness. In practice a dormant pool must be reheated with real answers, each of which costs an inference round, and the voyage of the check is peer-verifiable. Also: impose a per-identity emission ceiling so a farm must split into genuinely distinct workers. So the copper of a faked identity is priced, not computed.
